title.zh: 相册里的这些照片：你会怎样挑？

description.en: Six fictional photo-library choices about finding an image again, keeping a few favorites and making a small sequence. Find your camera-roll curation style.
description.zh: 六次虚构照片库选择，方便重找、留少数喜欢、排一段小序列，发现你的相册整理趣味。

introduction.en: Imagine a made-up camera roll; this quiz never accesses your actual photos. Choose how you would select and revisit its pictures. The result is about a small curation task, not memory ability or a requirement to delete or share anything.
introduction.zh: 想象一份编造相册；测试不会访问你的实际照片。选怎样挑选并回看图片。结果只谈小策展任务，不测记忆力，也不要求删除或分享东西。

focus.en: Making a fictional photo collection usable through retrieval, a small favorite set or a deliberate viewing sequence.
focus.zh: 整理虚构相册时，你更想方便查找、挑几张最喜欢的，还是排出一个观看顺序？

prompt.en: The imaginary roll contains many pictures from one day. You first…
prompt.zh: 想象相册里有同一天许多图，你先……

label.en: Make a simple way to find the day again.
label.zh: 做一个容易再找到这天的办法。

label.en: Choose a few pictures you actually want to revisit.

label.zh: 排一个有起止的短序列。

prompt.en: Several similar frames show the same moment. You prefer…
prompt.zh: 几张相似画面是同一瞬间，你更愿……

label.en: One favorite frame without needing it to represent everything.
label.zh: 一张喜欢的，不必代表全部。

label.en: A few contrasting frames that show a small change.
label.zh: 几张有对照、显出小变化的。

label.en: A clear grouping so you know where the set belongs.
label.zh: 分组清楚，知道整套归哪里。

prompt.en: You want to show a willing friend a small part. You…
prompt.zh: 想给愿意的朋友看一小部分，你会……

label.en: Select a short viewing order with an easy finish.
label.zh: 选短观看顺序，也方便结束。

label.en: Locate the few images relevant to what they asked about.
label.zh: 找与对方所问相关的几张。

label.en: Offer one favorite and let them choose whether to see more.
label.zh: 先给一张喜欢的，由对方选是否多看。

prompt.en: An old picture is difficult to locate. You wish you had…
prompt.zh: 一张旧图难找，你希望曾有……

label.en: A small ordinary label that matches how you search.
label.zh: 符合自己搜法的小普通标签。

label.en: A tiny favorite set where the picture could live.
label.zh: 可把它放进去的小喜欢集合。

label.en: A short story sequence that gives it a place.
label.zh: 让它有位置的一段短故事序列。

prompt.en: The collection feels too large for a relaxed look. You…
prompt.zh: 集合太大，难轻松看，你会……

label.en: Choose just a few favorites for this viewing.
label.zh: 只为本次观看选几张喜欢的。

label.en: Use one clear group rather than opening everything.
label.zh: 只用一个清楚分组，不全打开。

label.en: Make one brief sequence and leave the rest outside it.
label.zh: 排一段简短序列，其余先留在外面。

prompt.en: What makes the fictional roll enjoyable to return to?
prompt.zh: 什么让虚构相册值得回看？

label.en: I can find a particular thing without rebuilding the whole day.
label.zh: 找具体东西时，不必重建整天。

label.en: A small set is enough for a pleasant visit.
label.zh: 小集合就够愉快看一回。

label.en: The images make a little movement when seen in order.
label.zh: 图按顺序看，有一点推进。

summary.en: Your fictional roll becomes a place you can return to with a question. A small label or grouping helps a particular image reappear. The portrait values usable retrieval rather than treating a perfectly organized archive as a personal achievement you owe.
summary.zh: 你希望相册里的照片，以后还找得到。一个小标签或简单分组，就能帮你重新找到某张图。不必把整个相册整理得井井有条，只要它在需要时好用，就已经有意义。

example.en: You might name one small set after an outing’s ordinary theme, using words you would actually remember when looking for it later.
example.zh: 你可能按一次出游的主题给一小组照片命名，用自己以后找照片时真会想到的词。

strength.en: A simple retrieval cue can lower the effort of revisiting a collection and make one useful image available without sorting everything.
strength.zh: 一个简单的查找线索，就能减少翻相册的功夫。不必先整理全部照片，也能找到此刻需要的一张。

tradeoff.en: More labels can become harder to maintain than the pictures. A few cues that match your own searches may be enough.
tradeoff.zh: 标签一多，维护它们可能比整理照片还麻烦。留下几个符合自己查找习惯的提示，也许就够了。

experiment.en: For a fictional or already-owned small collection, add one label you would naturally search for. Test that cue once before creating a larger system.
experiment.zh: 给一小组虚构照片或自己已有的照片，加一个日后自然会想到的标签。先试试能否用它找回照片，再决定要不要整理更多。

summary.en: Your roll offers a small doorway rather than requiring a complete tour. A few chosen pictures can hold today’s enjoyment while the rest remain available. The result does not say the unchosen images are worthless or need removing.
summary.zh: 你更想先选几张喜欢的照片，给这次回看留一个轻松的入口，而不是要求自己把整个相册看完。今天只欣赏这几张也很好，其他照片可以以后再看。没选中的照片不等于没有价值，也不一定要删掉。

example.en: You might choose three ordinary images for a short shared look and leave the full day’s collection for another optional time.
example.zh: 你可能挑三张照片，和别人一起看一小会儿，把一整天拍下的其他照片留到下次想看时再翻。

strength.en: A small favorite set can make revisiting feel light enough to enjoy, especially when the whole collection is larger than the time you want to spend.
strength.zh: 只选几张喜欢的，能让回看照片轻松一些。尤其当照片很多，而你今天只想花一小会儿时，不必有看不完的负担。

tradeoff.en: Choosing only favorites can hide an unexpected detail in the wider set. An occasional open browse can offer another way to enjoy it.
tradeoff.zh: 只看最喜欢的几张，也可能错过其他照片里的有趣细节。偶尔不设目标地翻一翻，也能有另一种乐趣。

experiment.en: Pick a tiny set for one viewing and call it today’s selection, not the definitive best. Leave room to choose differently another time.
experiment.zh: 为今天这次观看挑几张照片，把它们叫作“今天想看的”，不用选出永远的最佳。以后完全可以换一组。

summary.en: Your pictures gain something from being seen in a chosen order. A beginning, contrast and ending can make a little movement between separate frames. The portrait follows this viewing preference rather than claiming your version is the true story of the day.
summary.zh: 你喜欢给照片安排一个观看顺序。一个开头、一处对照，再到一个结尾，分开的画面就能连成小故事。这是你选择的呈现方式，不代表它是那一天唯一真实的版本。

example.en: A wide view, a tiny detail and a final empty table might become a three-picture sequence about an ordinary shared afternoon.
example.zh: 一张全景、一处小细节，再加上一张人已散去的空桌，就能排成三张照片，讲述一个普通的共度下午。

strength.en: A short sequence can give another viewer a clear path through a small set without demanding they inspect every image equally.
strength.zh: 一个短短的顺序，能带着别人看完这一小组照片，不要求对方对每张图都花同样多的时间。

tradeoff.en: An elegant order can make a day look more coherent than it felt. A caption can keep the selection visibly a chosen edit.
tradeoff.zh: 精心安排的顺序，可能让一天看起来比亲历时更连贯。加一句说明，能让别人知道这只是你挑选和编排的一个版本。

experiment.en: Arrange three invented or shareable images into a short sequence, then try another order. Notice how the edit changes the little story.
experiment.zh: 把三张虚构的、或适合分享的图片排成一个短故事，再换一种顺序。看看同样的图片，怎样讲出不同的故事。

description.en: Curate an imagined photo collection through finding, favorites and sequence. Six choices reveal three ways to make a small set of pictures enjoyable to revisit.
description.zh: 用检索、精选与顺序，整理一组想象照片。六次选择，看看你怎样让一小组图片值得重看。

question.en: How are a favorites collection and a photo sequence different?
question.zh: 精选相册与按顺序讲故事，有什么不同？

answer.en: A favorites collection gives a few chosen images a place together; a sequence changes the viewing experience through order. Retrieval is a third purpose. The quiz uses imagined photos and never reads your real camera roll.
answer.zh: 精选把少量选定图片放在一起，顺序则通过先后改变观看体验；方便找回是第三种用途。本测试只用想象照片，不读取你的真实相册。
